# Security policy

This repository is Z6 Code, a fork of T3 Code. Report security vulnerabilities in Z6 Code
privately through GitHub: choose **Report a vulnerability** on this repository's
[Security tab](https://github.com/JeremiahDJordan/t3code/security/advisories/new). Please do not
open a public issue or disclose the problem until it has been investigated and fixed.

Z6 Code runs no hosted service. Vulnerabilities in upstream T3 Code that do not depend on this
fork's changes, and in T3 Tools-operated infrastructure (its hosted app, relay and accounts
site), go to T3 Tools as [upstream's security policy](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/security/policy)
describes. If you cannot tell which applies, report it here.
